term_definitions.Stopped short of B: referee arrived_short: the stack declared ARRIVED on its own pose estimate but the body ended outside the 2 m success radius
term_definitions.Stuck: referee stuck: < 0.5 m progress in 20 s
term_definitions.Out of bounds: referee out_of_bounds: body origin left the simulated terrain raster (0.5 m margin, metagross/sim/referee.py); not the robot's own rolling map
